errors.error_description: A combinational always block uses an explicit sensitivity list that omits the signal 'step' even though it is read inside the block, causing a simulation-synthesis mismatch.
The if/else chain assigns 'hold_flag' on some paths but not all in an always @(*) block, inferring a latch during synthesis.
A sequential block mixes non-blocking (<=) and blocking (=) assignments; 'rollover_q' is assigned with blocking inside a clocked block, creating potential race conditions.
The output net 'count_out' is driven by two concurrent continuous assignments, creating multiple active drivers on the same net.
